svg.title: British Columbia / Parks — simplified arms cap badge
svg.desc: Clean designed reconstruction of the photographed badge. Smooth geometry and outlined type replace all image-derived contours. Relief, hammered grain, ageing, reflections and display stands are omitted. Exact original typeface, die engraving and material tones cannot be authenticated; the few silver/bronze fills are a material interpretation. The cap-badge scroll family is shared, with a separate dogwood, simplified framed arms or full-arms centre. Petal relief and small engraved lettering are idealized. The visible old armorial edition uses the exact user-selected Plateforge 1917-late / Type 3 component with stroke weight 3 and uniform fit. Plateforge describes its source as a vector conversion of a generated master; it is not an authenticated original die, engraving or embroidery master.
